correction: Monthly anniversaries use the last valid day in shorter months and return to the original surgery day in later months. One source calendar-overflow correction is implemented; the detailed audit remains in the private project.
decisions: The final Daily Tracker rows take precedence over stale supporting notes: hydrating shampoo continues after the final foam wash until month 1.
V7 timing slots are the demo defaults. Personal Done/Skipped history and On hold statuses are not imported.
Sleeping position changes at day 7. Bucket hat is scheduled on days 1–10; its stop milestone is day 11.
Calendar months use original-date anniversaries with end-of-month clamping. Every-two-day shampoo cadence stays continuous when its rinse method changes.
ScarEx starts on day 2 and continues until the bottle is finished. A finish date is optional; the workbook’s last populated row is not an invented treatment stop.
Dermaroller uses the monthly cadence present in v7: months 10–21, twelve sessions. No second monthly session is invented.
ScarEx application location and quantity are not supplied by the final tracker; the demo refers to clinic application instructions instead of inventing them.
Dermosept Handplus appears as a name-only supporting note, outside the agreed 33-item daily catalog. No schedule has been invented for it.

items.name: Hair transplantation
items.instructions: Hair transplantation on the selected surgery date.

items.name: Paracetamol
items.instructions: If needed for pain: 1 tablet. Follow the prescribed dose limit.

items.name: Saline Spray
items.instructions: 3–6 sprays to implanted areas. No need to wake from sleep.

items.name: Sleeping position
items.instructions: Sleep on your back at 45° with a neck pillow.

items.name: Omeprazol (omeprazole)
items.instructions: 20 mg, 1 capsule before breakfast.

items.name: Coraspin (aspirin)
items.instructions: 100 mg, 1 tablet after breakfast.

items.name: Headband
items.instructions: Put on the headband for daytime wear. Remove it for the night.

items.name: Prednol
items.instructions: 16 mg, 1 tablet after breakfast.

items.name: Sifloks (ciprofloxacin)
items.instructions: 500 mg, 1 tablet after breakfast and after dinner, approximately 12 hours apart.

items.name: Bucket hat
items.instructions: Wear a loose bucket hat outside during sun or rain.

items.name: Moisturizer Repair Foam
items.instructions: Pat gently onto transplanted areas. Do not rub. Leave 30 minutes, then rinse gently with warm bottled water.

items.name: Hydrating Shampoo
items.instructions: Pat onto transplanted areas without rubbing. Wash donor area normally. Leave 1 minute, then rinse gently with warm bottled water.

items.name: Nicotine
items.instructions: Nicotine restriction ends.

items.name: Alcohol
items.instructions: Alcohol restriction ends.

items.name: Sexual activity
items.instructions: Sexual activity can resume.

items.name: ScarEx Jel
items.instructions: Apply according to the clinic’s application instructions. Stop when the bottle is finished.

items.name: Biotin
items.instructions: Take 1 tablet after a meal.

items.name: Complex Formula Multivitamin
items.instructions: Take 1 tablet after a meal.

items.name: Saw Palmetto
items.instructions: Take 1 tablet after a meal.

items.name: Finasteride + Minoxidil Topical Treatment
items.instructions: Apply 4–5 pumps and massage into scalp.

items.name: Normal hats / beanie
items.instructions: Normal hats or a beanie can be worn.

items.name: Anti Hair Loss Shampoo
items.instructions: Lather shampoo in hands, apply foam to scalp and rinse immediately.

items.name: Anti Hair Loss Serum
items.instructions: Spray 3–5 puffs into hair; leave in at least 5 hours.

items.name: Meso Hair Serum
items.instructions: Apply to head and leave in 12–24 hours.

items.name: Dermaroller + Meso Hair Serum
items.instructions: Prepare and clean as directed; perform treatment; apply serum; clean afterward.

items.name: Hair photographs
items.instructions: Take progress photos and submit to Cosmedica through its app.

items.name: Beard shaving
items.instructions: Beard shaving can resume.

items.name: Exercise
items.instructions: Exercise can resume.

items.name: Sun exposure
items.instructions: Sunbathing can resume.

items.name: Swimming
items.instructions: Swimming can resume.

items.name: Scissors haircut
items.instructions: Hair cutting with scissors can begin.

items.name: PRP Treatment
items.instructions: Contact the clinic about a six-month PRP visit.

items.name: Trimmer haircut
items.instructions: Hair cutting with a trimmer can begin.
